findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_packs, buy_pack, lookup_lead, email_pattern, repo_health · Private data: list_packs, buy_pack, lookup_lead, tech_stack, email_pattern, ssl_check, headers, dns, subdomains, contact_page, mail_provider, repo_health, deliverability, domain_intel, packsize · Public sink: list_packs, lookup_lead, email_pattern, mail_provider, deliverability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_packs, buy_pack, lookup_lead, email_pattern, repo_health · Private data: list_packs, buy_pack, lookup_lead, tech_stack, email_pattern, ssl_check, headers, dns, subdomains, contact_page, mail_provider, repo_health, deliverability, domain_intel, packsize · Public sink: list_packs, lookup_lead, email_pattern, mail_provider, deliverability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
